Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying assault of a child in the first degree provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to first degree assault of a child; and amendingRCW 9A.36.120.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9A.36.120 and 1992 c 145 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person eighteen years of age or older is guilty of the crimeof assault of a child in the first degree if the child is under the ageof thirteen and the person: (a) Commits the crime of assault in the first degree, as defined inRCW 9A.36.011, against the child; ((or)) (b) Intentionally assaults the child and ((either: (i))) recklessly inflicts great bodily harm; ((or (ii))) (c) Causes substantial bodily harm, and the person haspreviously engaged in a pattern or practice ((either)) of (((A)))assaulting the child which has resulted in bodily harm that is greaterthan transient physical pain or minor temporary marks((,)); or (((B))) (d) Causes substantial bodily harm, and the person haspreviously engaged in a pattern or practice of causing the child p. 1 HB 2726physical pain or agony that is equivalent to that produced by torture. (2) Assault of a child in the first degree is a class A felony.
